performance.note: Fixture times include compiler/cache/admission/replay. Lake module wall times include wrapper/lock queue waits and are not native process CPU times; native samples are isolated observations, not peaks or controlled benchmarks.

proofScope: Existing typed aggregate encoder and raw memory revert/catch operations reused. Kernel-specialized exact-buffer and bounded original-caller self-catch laws; six kernel-defined original entry programs; finite frontend/replay controls. No universal frontend/compiler/encoder equivalence theorem.
notes: All earlier commits, historical source/expectation/archive bytes, reports and exports preserved.
Final189 fresh fixtures are separate from248 retained unrun reports; this is not complete437 repair.

Superseded preliminary inventories stopped when confirmed slice-provenance, source-enum and require-constructor entrypoint gaps were repaired. Their reports remain preserved; the first copied slot1 metadata literal has a separate additive clarification. The final reviewed inventory has correct slot2 metadata and one final model hash.
Before-position zero sentinel is clarified in a separate artifact; the original diagnosis file is unchanged.
A metadata overwrite was rejected by automatic approval review; no rejected mutation ran. The safer additive clarification completed without changing preserved evidence.

Preliminary compilation/proof/control failures, including recovery axiom output from a failed exploratory check, are not final proof evidence; completed kernel checks have only the recorded standard axioms.
No new core dependency, axiom, sorry, raised heartbeat/fuel/timeout or resource cap introduced.
